label: Whenever x is not part of y, some part of x is disjoint from y…, by Typed-partial-order-supplemen…
meaning: Take a Sum2 fusion u of {x,y}. If every part of x overlaps y, the no-extra-parts clause implies every part of u overlaps y. Since y≤u, weak supplementation excludes y<u, so u=y and x≤y. Classical contraposition produces the separating remainder. Only binary Sum2 formation is used; no atomism, unrestricted-family formation or modal premises.
